description: Remove the DIRECTORY(ies), if they are empty.

option.name: --ignore-fail-on-non-empty
tip: ignore each failure to remove a non-empty directory

option.name: --parents
tip: remove DIRECTORY and its ancestors; e.g., 'rmdir -p a/b' is similar to 'rmdir a/b a'

option.name: --verbose
tip: output a diagnostic for every directory processed
